adultAgeYears.description: The age at which a person counts as an adult

pairOpinion.description: Two adults who like each other at least this much may become partners

courtingBonus.description: How much more an unpaired adult wants to talk to a possible partner

pairPercent.description: The chance each morning that such a pair becomes partners

fertileFromYears.description: The age at which a person can have children

fertileToYears.description: The age after which a person can no longer have children

conceptionPerMille.description: Chance per morning for a paired woman, in thousandths

pregnancyDays.description: Days a pregnancy lasts (three seasons of a 28-day year is 84)

childbirthDeathPercent.description: Chance in percent that childbirth kills the mother

birthSpacingYears.description: Years a mother nurses before the next child

famineStorePressure.description: No children are conceived while the store is this short (0 to 100)

oldAgeFromYears.description: The age from which old age can kill

oldAgePerMillePerYear.description: Daily chance of dying of old age, per year past oldAgeFromYears

feudOpinion.description: Two people who both think this badly of each other feud

parentChildOpinion.description: The opinion a parent and a child start with of each other

griefFeeling.description: The memory of losing close kin
